messages.text: Fofana tug-of-war! Sunderland, Palace agree deals - but where will he go?

metadata.summary: Crystal Palace and Sunderland have both agreed deals to sign Malick Fofana, leaving the winger at the centre of a transfer tug-of-war with his next destination still to be decided on Deadline Day.
metadata.content: Malick Fofana transfer news: Lyon winger at centre of Premier League tug-of-war as Crystal Palace and Sunderland agree deals | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Malick Fofana transfer news: Lyon winger at centre of Premier League tug-of-war as Crystal Palace and Sunderland agree deals Malick Fofana looked set to join Sunderland after the club made significant progress in their pursuit of the 20-year-old, who had also attracted interest from Arsenal; Palace moved to swoop in on Sunderland's deal; Black Cats have been given hope that their deal is still alive Tuesday 1 September 2026 17:51, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports Keith Downie explains how Lyon winger Malick Fofana had the choice of TWO private jets to the UK to seal a move to a Premier League club!! Crystal Palace and Sunderland have both agreed deals to sign Malick Fofana, leaving the winger at the centre of a transfer tug-of-war with his next destination still to be decided on Deadline Day. Fofana had looked set to join Sunderland after the Black Cats made significant progress in their pursuit of the 20-year-old, who had also attracted interest from Arsenal. Sky Sports News understands Fofana was at Lyon airport on Tuesday afternoon with two private jets waiting for him to make his decision - one bound for London and the other for Sunderland.
